articles.title: Amazon Stock Is Slumping. But The Tech Giant Just Dethroned Walmart For This Milestone.
articles.mainIdea: Amazon Stock Is Slumping. But The Tech Giant Just Dethroned Walmart For This Milestone.
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Amazon Stock Is Slumping. But The Tech Giant Just Dethroned Walmart For This Milestone.. Amazon has officially dethroned Walmart as the world's largest company by revenue. Walmart's fiscal Q4 results on Thursday showed Amazon pulling ahead in 12-month revenue for the first time, a milestone forecasted by Amazon stock analysts coming into 2025. Walmart on Thursday reported annual sales of $713.2 billion for the 12 months ending Jan. 31, compared to Amazon's $716.9 billion in sales for the 12-months ended Dec. 31. Related tickers mentioned: WMT.
